title: pauseJob request
description: POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}:pause - request. Pauses the job: no more tasks start; leased tasks finish (US-08.2.1).
$comment: Source: DISENO S4 (b), (d) StartFanOutUseCase/CancelFanOutUseCase/FanOutStatusQuery, (e) operator APIs (RF-121), AP-F6, AP-F7; PRD RF-121, RF-022; US-08.2.1. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); job view is OPERATIONAL (counters, no engagement ids). Idempotency: Idempotency-Key required; idempotent transition (already PAUSED -> same 200). Pagination: n/a.

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120). idempotency-key is required on every write (DISENO 3.8.5, DEC-35).
